articles.title: Pokémon Pokopia's Bubbly Basin DLC Dives into Risky Waters
articles.summary: Pokémon Pokopia's first expansion, Bubbly Basin, introduces underwater exploration with the new Dive move. But underwater levels have a terrible track record in gaming. Can a cozy life sim break the curse?

articles.title: Wooting 60HE v2: The Magnetic Keyboard That Redefines Gaming Precision
articles.summary: The Wooting 60HE v2 uses Hall Effect magnetic sensors for unparalleled key control. With an 8,000 Hz polling rate and deep customization, it lets you map walk and sprint to the same key. But its compact layout and SOCD feature stir debate.

articles.title: Ryan Lochte Announces Engagement to Molly Gillihan in a Full-Circle Moment
articles.summary: Four-time Olympian Ryan Lochte proposed to girlfriend Molly Gillihan at a Gainesville restaurant—the site of their first date. In an emotional Instagram post, Lochte credited Gillihan with helping him through a difficult period of personal recovery.
